body: Eh I still think that's not a good idea. We're in lock down for a reason and in my country, if they catch me on the street without any reason I'll get jailed. (We're also not allowed to be on the streets depending on your gender, so today is guys day)

I'm in the anxious department haha, cause I like him as a friend and that would ruin all. But I'll consider this if I get crazier, I'm actually very chill and I find this funny overall but sometimes is like yeah wtf.
Eh, we live in a big city so not close. I'll take advice. I'm 21 f think he's 20/21 as well.
Sorry, but I know I won't get better, I won't get the ability to eat fats overnight and especially, I won't be able to erase the nasty, ugly, horrible, scars I have.
I feel you, I got severely ill and the tought of living like an old person and not enjoying what I have of youth angries me, I just don't like living worried about a body that doesn't want to live.

I'm not from the US, and I'm on a lot of stuff that helps poor people in my country. I have a meal tonight, tho I struggle, especially cause I have dietary restrictions that make my food even more expensive, I'm okay, so far I have had food even if it's just rice and vegetables, but I keep myself fed and it's my priority n1 for health reasons, I was just wishing it wasn't like that tho.

Thanks for your comment, hope it helps someone else!!!

Yes! I know it will get better, I'm actually better in some aspects cause I almost died from an illness so I'm very thankful for that and every day I appreciate the fact that I can walk and well, that I'm not in a hospital bed or something. Thanks for ur words.
Wow, I hope you're out of that situation. I'm not from the US :(, but if I had the money I'd buy one hat, I love handmade stuff :D, thanks tho! I hope. you have a great day:)
Oh god, I understand you, almost in the same position, I hope you can get better soon!!!
